name: Sadistic Little
original_name: サディスティックりとる
source:
Takahata Kousuke, a rookie teacher with some very hardcore otaku hobbies,
ends up having his biggest, most embarrassing secret—tied directly to those hobbies—discovered by none other than his two favorite students.

From that day on, the relationship between teacher and students flips completely.
No longer just a teacher, Kousuke becomes their slave, and the two girls, fueled by their youth and competitive streaks, start pushing him to his limits, each trying to outdo the other.

And so begins the protagonist’s life of suffering, caught in the crossfire of their rivalry.


[Translated from [url=http://www.masterup.net/momoiro/product/little/]the official website[/url]]
translation:
高畑康介，一位有着一些非常铁杆宅男爱好的新人老师，
最终他最大、最尴尬的秘密——与这些爱好直接相关——被他最喜欢的两个学生发现。

从那天起，师生关系彻底翻转。
浩介不再只是一名老师，而是成为了他们的奴隶，两个女孩在她们的青春和好胜心的推动下，开始把他推向极限，每个人都试图超越对方。

主人公陷入相互竞争的痛苦生活就这样开始了。


[翻译自[url=http://www.masterup.net/momoiro/product/little/]官网[/url]]
